items.question: Find the first name and age of students who have a dog but do not have a cat as a pet.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.fname ,  T1.age FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'dog' AND T1.stuid NOT IN (SELECT T1.stuid FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'cat')

items.question: Find the average weight for each pet type.
items.gold_sql: SELECT avg(weight) ,  pettype FROM pets GROUP BY pettype

items.question: What is the maker of the carr produced in the earliest year and what year was it?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Make ,  T1.Year FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Year  =  (SELECT min(YEAR) FROM CARS_DATA);

items.question: What are the different models for the cards produced after 1980?
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T3 ON T2.MakeId  =  T3.id WHERE T3.year  >  1980;

items.question: What is the number of makers of care in France?
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.Country  =  T2.CountryId WHERE T2.CountryName  =  'france';

items.question: What are all the makers and models?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Maker ,  Model FROM MODEL_LIST;

items.question: What are the makers and models?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Maker ,  Model FROM MODEL_LIST;

items.question: Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent  =  T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId  =  T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent  =  'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >=  3;

items.question: What is the code of airport that has fewest number of flights?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.AirportCode FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport OR T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1

items.question: Find all airlines that have flights from airport 'CVO' but not from 'APG'.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "CVO" EXCEPT SELECT T1.Airline FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.uid  =  T2.Airline WHERE T2.SourceAirport  =  "APG"

items.question: Find the number of employees hired in each shop; show the shop name as well.
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t2.name

items.question: Give me all the information about hiring.
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM hiring

items.question: What is all the information about hiring?
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM hiring

items.question: Show all document ids and the number of paragraphs in each document. Order by document id.
items.gold_sql: SELECT document_id ,  count(*) FROM Paragraphs GROUP BY document_id ORDER BY document_id

items.question: What are the ids of documents that contain the paragraph text 'Brazil' and 'Ireland'?
items.gold_sql: SELECT document_id FROM Paragraphs WHERE paragraph_text  =  'Brazil' INTERSECT SELECT document_id FROM Paragraphs WHERE paragraph_text  =  'Ireland'

items.question: List the name of teachers whose hometown is not "Little Lever Urban District".
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Hometown != "Little Lever Urban Distric"

items.question: What are the names of the teachers and how many courses do they teach?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name ,  COUNT(*) FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name

items.question: What are the names of the teachers whose courses have not been arranged?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Teacher_id NOT IN (SELECT Teacher_id FROM course_arrange)

items.question: What are the opening year and staff number of the museum named Plaza Museum?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Num_of_Staff ,  Open_Year FROM museum WHERE name  =  'Plaza Museum'

items.question: What is the name of the museum that had no visitor yet?
items.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE Museum_ID NOT IN (SELECT museum_id FROM visit)

items.question: List the names of all winners who played in both 2013 and 2016.
items.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR  =  2013 INTERSECT SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR  =  2016

items.question: Find the average ranking for each player and their first name.
items.gold_sql: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

items.question: What are the first names of all players, and their average rankings?
items.gold_sql: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

items.question: Find the number of matches happened in each year.
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR

items.question: List the name, date and result of each battle.
items.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  date FROM battle

items.question: How is the math course described?
items.gold_sql: SELECT course_description FROM Courses WHERE course_name  =  'math'

items.question: How many departments offer any degree?
items.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

items.question: Find the kind of program which most number of students are enrolled in?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the program which most number of students are enrolled in. List both the id and the summary.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_program_id ,  T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_program_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the last name of the students who currently live in the state of North Carolina but have not registered in any degree program.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

items.question: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

items.question: Find the first name of the students who permanently live in the country Haiti or have the cell phone number 09700166582.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.permanent_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.country  =  'Haiti' UNION SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE cell_mobile_number  =  '09700166582'

items.question: What is minimum and maximum share of TV series?
items.gold_sql: SELECT max(SHARE) , min(SHARE) FROM TV_series;

items.question: What is the produdction code and channel of the most recent cartoon?
items.gold_sql: SELECT production_code ,  channel FROM cartoon ORDER BY original_air_date LIMIT 1

items.question: List the final tables made and the best finishes of poker players.
items.gold_sql: SELECT Final_Table_Made ,  Best_Finish FROM poker_player

items.question: What are the final tables made and best finishes for all poker players?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Final_Table_Made ,  Best_Finish FROM poker_player

items.question: Of all the contestants who got voted, what is the contestant number and name of the contestant who got least votes?
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.contestant_number , T1.contestant_name FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number GROUP BY T1.contestant_number ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: List the area codes in which voters voted both for the contestant 'Tabatha Gehling' and the contestant 'Kelly Clauss'.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling' INTERSECT SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Kelly Clauss'

items.question: What region does Angola belong to and what is its population?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Population ,  Region FROM country WHERE Name  =  "Angola"

items.question: Which countries have either English or Dutch as an official language?
items.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND IsOfficial  =  "T" UNION SELECT * FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "Dutch" AND IsOfficial  =  "T"

items.question: Which countries have greater area than that of any country in Europe?
items.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE SurfaceArea  >  (SELECT min(SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Europe")

items.question: Show the names of high schoolers who have likes, and numbers of likes for each.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id

items.question: Find the id and cell phone of the professionals who operate two or more types of treatments.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

items.question: What are the first name and last name of the professionals who have done treatment with cost below average?
items.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 WHERE cost_of_treatment  <  ( SELECT avg(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments )

items.question: What are the arriving date and the departing date of all the dogs?
items.gold_sql: SELECT date_arrived ,  date_departed FROM Dogs

items.question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.
items.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

items.question: Return the first name, last name and email of the owners living in a state whose name contains the substring 'North'.
items.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

items.question: Show the property type descriptions of properties belonging to that code.
items.gold_sql: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code

items.question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
items.gold_sql: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
